label: Swimming
help: Official: on the province's tested bathing-water list. Pool: a summer or outdoor pool. Allowed, not official: not banned, but untested. No swimming: banned or unsafe.

label: When
help: When it's on, if not all summer: e.g. May to September, July and August, weekends.

label: Good to know
help: Practical: crowds and the best time to go, algae or swimmer's itch warnings, what to bring, shade, toilets, wheelchair access.

label: In summer
